verdict.rationale: Insomnia's design view lets developers build and iterate on OpenAPI specs (insomnia-docs-5), with a live preview (insomnia-docs-16) and automatic linting (insomnia-docs-17), plus CI linting via inso (insomnia-docs-49). A community user reports replacing Swagger Editor with it (insomnia-comm-12). Since the design document is authored natively in OpenAPI, the output is OpenAPI, though explicit export docs are thin: the import/export page lists OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 (insomnia-docs-8) but frames those formats mainly as imports (insomnia-docs-19). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an OpenAPI export workflow, and hands-on corroboration of exporting a designed spec.
